title: Energy Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for the energy of the particle in the ground state must be provided.

title: Momentum Probability
description: Essential Criteria: The correct probability expression for the momentum of the particle must be given.

title: Energy Conservation Explanation
description: Important Criteria: A clear explanation of how energy conservation is maintained during the wall separation must be included.

title: Wave Function Understanding
description: Important Criteria: The response should demonstrate an understanding of how the wave function behaves when the walls are removed.

title: Integration Setup
description: Optional Criteria: The setup for integrating to find the average energy after wall separation should be correctly outlined.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any inconsistencies in units throughout the calculations will result in a deduction.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign mistakes in the expressions for energy or probability will lead to a deduction.
